verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents whether Cactus-downloaded model files or caches can be shared with, or imported from, other runtimes. What it does show points toward the opposite: HuggingFace models must be converted with `cactus convert` (marked experimental), and a community report notes models download inline at runtime with no separate cache API. Because the axis applies to an on-device inference engine but no first-party documentation addresses cross-runtime reuse, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
